title: 🔔 Apple Warns iPhone Users in 99 Countries of a Spyware Attack!
body: 🔔 Apple Warns iPhone Users in 99 Countries of a Spyware Attack!
Apple has sent threat notifications to users in Germany starting from 29 October, warning them that their phones may be targeted by a government-backed spyware attack.

Germany's Federal Office for Information Security also issued a notice to members of parliament and public figures, asking them to assume their phones were compromised if they received an Apple notification over the weekend.
The warnings were not limited to Germany: the latest batch of notifications reached users in 99 countries around the world, in one of the widest warning waves of this kind.

Apple sends these notifications only when it detects a targeted attack by "mercenary" spyware sold to governments — attacks that do not target the general public, but usually journalists, politicians, and activists.
Simply put: when Apple itself warns you about spyware, this is not an ordinary announcement; it is a warning that your phone has become a specific target, and it must be taken completely seriously.
Do you know what to do if you receive a threat notification from Apple on your phone?
